full_judgment:
2. The facts of the case relevant for disposal of the instant leave petition are that on 15.02.2000 at about 8.00 a.m. the accused, Md. Shafiul Azam Chowdhury alias Shafi alias Mohammad Shafiul Azam, Nurul Alam, Nurul Absar, Saiful Islam, Uzzal Barua, Nurul Islam and Golam Mawla being armed with deadly weapons, illegally trespassed into vacant land lying beside the home of the informant, S.M. Iqbal Hossain, and tried to construct a boundary wall thereon. The informant S.M. Iqbal Hossain along with his family members and sister's husband Harun (deceased) went to the place of occurrence to restrain the illegal activities of those accused persons. At one stage, the accused persons surrounded the informant and his companions, and they raised hue and cry to rescue them. The informant S.M. Iqbal Hossain asked Harun (since deceased), to inform the matter to the police. When Harun tried to go to inform the police, accused Saiful Azam fired a gun shot at the chest of victim Harun with his own firearm, and as a result, Harun fell down on the ground. The other accused persons made blank shots from their firearms. The informant party raised hue and cry, then the people of the neighboring houses came to the place of occurrence and the accused persons tried to flee away from the place of occurrence. The assembled people caught accused Shafiul Azam Chowdhury alias Shafi red-handed with his firearm and the other two accused persons namely, Saiful Islam and Uzzal Barua were also caught by the patrol police with the help of local people. Thereafter, injured Harun was taken to and admitted to the Medical College Hospital, Chittagong, where he succumbed to his injuries at 3.30 p.m. on that day. The further case of the prosecution is that, the accused persons at the instance of Golam Mawla and Nurul Islam, at a secret meeting at night, made a plan, with a view to take forcible possession of the disputed boundary and also constructs a wall. The accused persons with the common object trespassed on to the disputed land and tried to construct a wall. Hence, the informant lodged the instant case with Panchlish Police Station against the accused persons under Sections 147/148/149/302/109 of the Penal Code. 

 3. After investigation police submitted Charge-Sheet being No. 260 dated 10.08.2000 against the five accused per-sons, including the petitioner having found prima facie case made out against them under sections 147/148/149/447/302 of the Penal Code. Upon a naraji petition filed by the informant the Court ordered further investigation by the CID who submitted a supplementary Charge Sheet being No. 6 dated 18.01.2002 implicating two additional accused persons. The case was transferred to the Divisional Druta Bichar Tribunal, Chittagong which framed charge against the accused appellants under sections 149/447/302 of the Penal Code. The accused appellants present in the dock pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. 

 5. The defence case, apparent from the trend of cross-examination of the prosecution witnesses, was that no such occurrence took place at the time, in the manner and at the place of occurrence as alleged by the prosecution and the victim was shot in the melee from his own side, but the accused were implicated falsely due to previous grudge and enmity. 

 7. The petitioner filed Criminal Appeal No. 165 of 2005 which was heard along with Death Reference No. 4 of 2005 and also Criminal Appeal No. 400 of 2005 and Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 11065 of 2005 were filed by other co-convicts.
